target_customer: Frontier AI and robotics model teams buying custom training data
problem: Robotics and physical AI models fail for lack of trustworthy, well-provenanced real-world data such as egocentric video, UMI demonstrations and teleoperation.
business_model: Custom data collection projects plus reusable rights-cleared data products
product_category: Training data for robotics and physical AI

founders.name: Nikhil Reddy
founders.background_notes: YC page says he held quant and SWE internships (employers not named) and in 2023 disclosed loopholes in data annotation platforms.

founders.name: Jeffrey Lin
founders.background_notes: Head of Data for the NYU Robotics Team per YC page; AI/ML and SWE internships, employers not named.

competitors.name: Labelbox Terra
competitors.what: Robotics data engine covering egocentric and teleoperated demonstrations

competitors.name: Lightwheel
competitors.what: Egocentric data platform (EgoSuite) for robot training

competitors.name: Mecka AI
competitors.funding_then: Reported $60M raise in October 2026, after Datoric's batch start

technical_complexity.rationale: Contributor apps, provenance tracking and fraud models are standard engineering, but quality control across modalities at scale is hard for two people.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive collections and contributor networks can compound, but many vendors sell similar egocentric data and customers can switch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to know; larger labelers were moving into physical AI data in 2026.

market_need_then: Robotics labs were buying large volumes of egocentric video in 2026, with reports of foundation models pretrained on over a million hours of first-person video.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and mission-driven, 'foundational data layer for AI in the physical world'

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found about the brand; name resembles Datorama and DatoCMS.

outcome_analysis: Datoric is a two-person company in a hot physical AI data market, claiming nearly seven figures of revenue in 30 days in its launch post and over 300,000 contributors. No outcome events were found. Funding is unknown. Risks are crowded vendors and customer concentration, so the story is unresolved.
notes: No funding found, so no rounds recorded. Third-party trackers (Round Funded, YC Tier List) list Datoric as Winter 2026 while YC page and directory say Summer 2026; unresolved. Revenue and contributor claims are from the company's own launch post. Another tracker lists the same founders at a company called Arzule. Competitor traction is from vendor blogs and unverified.
